shortDescription: Published (Workshop 3786107692), update in prep. Shared foundation for the Radius UI suite: one colour set, one card/hover treatment, a shape module, a text field, a scroll widget, a font resolver, a world-map bake, a Perf module, and a 272-icon shared art library.
body:
## What this mod is

A **library mod**. It adds no defs, no world state, and no Harmony patches. It exists so the
Radius UI suite draws with one design language instead of many forked copies of one.

Design language: flat 2.0, rounded, iOS-like, colour-forward.

Architecture of record: `_dev/RadiusUIFramework/ARCHITECTURE.md` (human-owned). Nothing in
`_dev/` ships.

## Status: PUBLISHED, generation 5 update in publish prep

- **Steam Workshop: 3786107692** - first published 2026-08-18.
- **Git: `Astryls/Radius-UI-Framework`** (private), branch `main`. Autosave task commits every
  15 min, so work lands in history without an explicit commit.
- Licence: MIT.

### Publish prep status (2026-08-20)

Backup taken: `D:\Rimworld\Radius UI Framework\20260820-083608` (502 files verified).

**Gates passing:** Release build 0 warnings with `DebugType=none`; `Assemblies/` holds exactly
one DLL and no `.pdb`; zero em/en/minus dashes across About.xml, LICENSE, Languages and all 41
`.cs`; keyed strings reconcile with 0 missing and 0 orphans (the 8 `RadiusUI.Accent.*` keys are
composed at runtime, not orphans); `Preview.png` exactly 1280x720; `ModIcon.png` present
(256x256); 272 declared texture paths = 272 PNGs on disk, nothing missing or unreferenced in
either direction; no source art anywhere. The two items previously outstanding (missing
ModIcon, orphan `RadiusUI.Settings.PreviewCard`) are both resolved.

**Blocking / outstanding:**

1. **Stray nested copy.** `RadiusUIFramework/RadiusUIFramework/` is a real directory holding a
   duplicate of the mod (About, Assemblies incl. a pdb, Languages, LICENSE, `.modmixer`) plus
   **its own `.git`**. The parent repo tracks it as a gitlink (mode 160000, commit 4f5fe714).
   Publishing as-is uploads a duplicate mod and a full git history including the private remote
   URL. Removal is `git rm --cached RadiusUIFramework && rm -rf RadiusUIFramework`; awaiting
   go-ahead.
2. Missing docs required by `_dev/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md`: `FIELD_MANUAL.md`,
   `STEAM_DESCRIPTION.txt`, `steam-description.html`, `UPDATE_NOTES.txt`, `HELICOPTER_VIEW.md`.
3. Clean-load test and Dubs performance sign-off not run for generation 5.
4. The folder strip itself (`_dev/publish-prep.ps1`; no hold currently outstanding).
5. About.xml `<description>` still describes the pre-generation-4 framework. Harmless for the
   upload - the uploader never updates the description on an existing item - but the Steam web
   editor copy needs refreshing by hand.

## Publish contract (GLOBAL_RULES §6)

Shipped folder is runtime-only: `About/`, `Assemblies/`, `Languages/`, `Textures/`, `LICENSE`.
Release with `DebugType=none`, so no `.pdb` and no Harmony DLL. `.modmixer/` stays in place -
removing it makes Modmixer restamp About.xml's author to the lowercase default handle and
re-serialize the description.

## Texture library (272 icons, 19 categories)

Imported from five source mods. All byte-for-byte copies: no resampling, no recolouring.
Generation 5 added a `Need/` category (4 icons) pairing with `Palette.Needs`.

Namespaced under `Textures/RadiusUI/` because `ContentFinder` returns the *last-loaded* match,
so an un-namespaced sibling in a consumer would silently shadow it. Consumers must delete their
local copies, not merely stop referencing them.

### The art is three tiers, not one family

Only tier 1 can be re-themed:

- **Glyphs** - flat white RGB, all information in alpha. Tinted via `Palette`/accent.
- **Illustrations (`Anatomy/`)** - shaded beige art. Never tinted.
- **Semantic markers (`Marker/`)** - colour *is* the meaning; mapped to the semantic ramp. Hand
  synced to the palette: if the ramp changes, those 8 PNGs must be re-authored.

### Aliases are a hard requirement

12 retired names must stay exposed as aliases or consumer call sites break. `Squad/` ships 5
files but offers 8 emblem slots; `Reminder/` ships 7 but offers 8 picker slots.
`Action/LockOpen` and `Action/LockClosed` scored 0.927 similarity and were deliberately kept
apart - they are a **state pair**.

**No magnifier/search glyph exists**, deliberately: `FlatField` ships with no leading icon
rather than misusing `Action/EyeOpen`. If one is wanted it must be authored as a tier-1
flat-white glyph, at which point `FlatField` can take an optional leading `RadiusIcon`.

## Components

- `Tokens/` - `Palette` (+ Health, Ideology, Needs, Social, Bands partials), `Metrics`
  (+ Rows partial). Pure values.
- `Chrome/` - `CardChrome` (the rounded card), `FlatField` (the text field), `Spatial`
  (+ Bands partial - the shape vocabulary).
- `Widgets/` - `FlatScroll`, `UIKit` (+ Bars partial).
- `Icons/` - `RadiusIcon` (art tier lives here), `IconSet` + generated per-tier partials.
- `Text/RadiusFont` - framework-owned font resolution and measurement.
- `World/WorldSnapshot` - real-terrain minimap bake + `TerritoryPaint`.
- `Settings/`, `Compat/ModCompat`, `Perf/`.

Several classes are `partial` (`Spatial`, `UIKit`, `Metrics`, `Palette`, `IconSet`) so
concurrent sessions add a **file** instead of editing a shared one. That is now the §13
recommendation and it is what let two sessions work this tree simultaneously.

### `Chrome/FlatField` - the flat text field

`Draw(rect, text, controlName, placeholder, clearButton)` returns the edited text. Uplifted
from Faction Menu, where it was proven as the rail search box.

Framework-owned for the same reason `RadiusFont` is: it is **shared-GUIStyle surgery**.
`Widgets.TextField` draws with `Text.CurTextFieldStyle`, whose eight state backgrounds are
vanilla's tan bevel, so a consumer that draws its own plate merely puts a flat surface *under*
vanilla chrome. The only fix is a copy of that style with all eight backgrounds nulled.

Four encoded rules: never mutate the shared style (and note `GUI.skin.textField` is a pure
no-op here - `Widgets.TextField` never reads it); copy from `Text.textFieldStyles[Small]`, not
`CurTextFieldStyle`, which resolves against ambient `Text.Font`; cache behind an epoch guard on
both the source style object and its font; `GUI.SetNextControlName` immediately before
`GUI.TextField` or focus detection silently never matches. `GUI.skin.settings` is untouched.

The clear button's `ButtonInvisible` and its 24px reserve are emitted whenever `clearButton` is
true, not only when non-empty: the caller assigns the return value, so an empty field can become
non-empty between the input pass and the Repaint pass of one frame, and a control appearing
mid-frame renumbers every control the caller draws after it.

### `Chrome/Spatial` - the shape module (§15)

What `CardChrome` structurally cannot draw. F1 established that rounding does **not** need a
procedural 9-slice (Unity's per-corner overload handles fills and outlines), but that overload
cannot do a shadow, disc, ring or capsule. Ends a four-way fork; `BottomBand` alone had three.
A lift of Modern Social Tab's implementation, not a rewrite.

Generated textures only, no shipped art, so nothing to declare in `cs-assets.json`. `Well`,
`Capsule`/`Surface`/`Card`/`RowPlate`/`Chip`, `Pill`, `Dot`, `Ring`, `Elevate`, `BottomBand`,
`Glyph`. `Spatial.Rounded = false` degrades everything to square with no call site touched.

Cost discipline: a 9-slice is nine draw calls, so it is for surfaces and row cards only; `Pill`
is three; faint row stripes stay square. `Pill` samples **half** discs by texcoord because whole
discs under a rect double-draw the caps, which is invisible at full alpha and renders as three
lumps below it. `BottomBand` clips rather than shrinks, and registers nothing interactive inside
the clip. All textures are `HideAndDontSave` or `UnloadUnusedAssets` destroys them mid-session.

### `World/WorldSnapshot` - real-terrain minimap bake (§16)

Bounded BFS from a centre tile, rasterising each tile's actual polygon onto the tangent plane so
cells tessellate like the vanilla world map. 768² `Color32`, ~2.3 MB reused, ~5 ms upload,
cached on centre/range/orientation/paint key. Third occurrence of the technique (Wayfarers ->
Faction Menu -> Ideology), promoted unchanged so the copies cannot drift.

`TerritoryPaint` carries the claim overlay and is **immutable** to the bake: a changed claim map
must arrive as a new `Key` or the cache returns a stale texture. Use `Transport` to
parallel-transport the basis across a re-centre; deriving it from a fixed world axis makes north
swing and reads as the map rotating. Square texture and limb cull are deliberate departures from
the original. Terrain colours are map **content**, so this file does not route through `Palette`.

### `Perf/` - hot-path utilities

Extracted from HUD and Colonist Bar before they migrate: `FrameGate`, `Throttle`, `TextMemo`,
`ScratchText`, `SnapshotTable`, `IdMap`, `PooledWindowState`, `ViewCull`, `PatchGuard`,
`DefTable`, `FrameProbe`. Main-thread only, deliberately not thread safe.

`RadiusFont.Size/Height/Width` now route through `TextMemo` behind unchanged signatures.
`RadiusThemeSettings.refreshMult` (0.5..4, default 1) backs `Throttle.EveryScaled`.

## Binding rules for framework edits (§13)

Additive only; never change the value behind an existing name; missing token means add a new
one; **rebuild every consumer after any framework rebuild** and hash-verify their game-side
copies; the 12 icon aliases are permanent. Prefer a new `partial` file over editing a shared
one. Framework `Source/` receives concurrent pushes - always re-read a file from disk
immediately before editing it, **including ARCHITECTURE.md** (§1 was rewritten under this
session mid-edit).

## Known issues

- Game-side `RimWorld/Mods/RadiusUIFramework` is a **real directory, not a symlink**, and its
  DLL has drifted stale. Consumers are symlinked and stay live, so the running game can pair new
  consumer DLLs with an old framework DLL - the MissingMethodException setup §13 rule 4 exists
  to prevent. Needs a sync pass.
- Faction Menu still carries its own `Source/Core/WorldSnapshot.cs` fork and must be re-pointed
  at the framework copy. Deferred deliberately: that consumer is live and its StagePane wiring
  was unreviewed.
- Faction Menu's local `Chrome/FlatField.cs` is redundant and pending deletion.
